newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Cimpor to boost turnover 15-20 pct '97 vs '96.
newsitem.headline: Cimpor to boost turnover 15-20 pct '97 vs '96.

text.p: Portuguese cement firm Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal expected to boost turnover by 15 to 20 percent in 1997, compared with 1996, its president, Antonio Sousa Gomes said.
"Turnover should grow (in 1997) by at least 15 percent and probably up to 20 percent," he told a news conference.
"Turnover is expected to reach 250 billion escudos by 2000, and productive capacity between 13 and 15 million tonnes."
Cimpor earlier reported that turnover stood at 128.3 billion escudos in 1996, up from 118.7 billion in 1995.
It posted a consolidated net profit of 19.7 billion escudos in 1996, up from 18.4 billion in 1995.
